Questions

What is the median annual wage for Construction laborers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Construction Laborers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $60,890.

What is the hourly median for Construction laborers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Construction Laborers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $29.27.

How many Construction laborers work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 26,690 wage-and-salary Construction Laborers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Construction laborers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.84. Values above 1.00 mean Construction Laborers are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Construction laborers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Construction Laborers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $69,180.

How does Chicago's Construction laborers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($60,890) is $16,890 higher than Austin ($44,000) and $1,150 higher than Seattle ($59,740). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
